title: An MCP tool's description and parameters reach the model as the server wrote them, within bounds
notes: A tool's definition is its server's declaration, handed to the model in the API's tools, not in a text of the runtime: not framed, a forged closing tag and a copy of a runtime mark kept as written. It is bounded: a 4,899-character description is cut at a word within 4,096 characters, and a tool whose name is longer than 128 characters is left out.
